title: TS-07 Cognito verifier and principal resolution
description:
## Slice 2 ticket 7 of 40, phase notes: paths use `conversation/` (the workspace as it is on develop). Design source: `git show origin/docs/typescript-control-plane:docs/TYPESCRIPT_CONTROL_PLANE.md` (section 8, row 7); read sections 0.3, 2, 3 and 6 as needed. Read AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md first. Never read or write `project/`; use `kbs` only.

## Goal
Verify Cognito id tokens with aws-jwt-verify, resolve the caller to a Principal in the exact dependency order of the Python principal, and cache membership for 30 seconds. The JWKS-injection call for tests is uncertain, so a prototype comes first.

## Kind
prototype-first: a library API in this ticket is uncertain. A Sonnet agent must FIRST produce verified, runnable code for it (see Prototype section), paste it into this ticket as a comment, and ONLY THEN is the ticket completed with that code verbatim. A Haiku implementer must not start the build part until that comment exists; if it is missing, stop and report.

...work, then...

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"

## Exported interface and error behavior
`verifyIdToken(token: string): Promise<Claims>` with `Claims = {email: string; emailVerified: true; sub: string}`; throws `Unauthorized` for any invalid, expired, wrong-client token, and for `email_verified !== true`. Identity is email-keyed: `sub` is never used as identity. `resolvePrincipal(request: Request, deps): Promise<Principal>` with `Principal = {kind: "user"|"operator"|"worker"|"integration"; tenantId: string; userId: string; role: Role}`, order: bearer present (401); reject a worker token on a user route (403); integration-test token; Cognito verify; identity by email; membership for the path tenant (403); org status ENABLED (403); role. `MembershipCache` is a bounded (max 1000 entries) in-memory map keyed `tenant:user` with a 30000 ms TTL taken from the injected Clock.

General rules: TypeScript ESM, `.ts` import suffixes as in conversation/src/storage/; tabs for indentation as in existing files; long clear names; no line comments; TSDoc on exported symbols; no emojis. Each Python exception class used by a ported function becomes an exported `Error` subclass with the same name and the same message text. Failures are thrown, never returned as magic values, unless the Python returned them.

Rule: mechanical ports keep the Python file's structure and cite the Python line range in the commit body. Behavior that no scenario encodes is still kept.

## Prototype (must be done and pasted before the build)
A Sonnet agent first produces verified code for: (1) constructing `CognitoJwtVerifier.create({userPoolId, tokenUse: "id", clientId})` from `aws-jwt-verify` at the exact installed version, (2) injecting a test JWKS (generated with `jose` generateKeyPair RS256 and exportJWK) into the verifier with its `cacheJwks` method so no network call is made, (3) minting a token that verifies and showing that a token signed by another key, an expired token, and a wrong audience each throw. The code and the pinned versions are pasted into the ticket as a comment; the ticket is then completed with that code verbatim. Do not guess the method names.
